response.justification: While Bogdan has senior-level experience and some capital markets exposure at RIDE Capital, he fundamentally lacks the mandatory technical requirements for this role. His C++ experience is minimal (approximately 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) and severely outdated, far short of the required 5-10 years. His recent career has consistently moved toward full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than systems programming, with no evidence of Windows platform expertise or strong SQL Server/Oracle proficiency. The technical and domain mismatch is substantial.
strengths: Senior-level professional with 20+ years in software engineering and demonstrated ability to work on complex technical systems
Capital markets exposure through RIDE Capital role, showing capability to engage with financial services concepts and investment domain
Strong CI/CD pipeline expertise and Java background, both desirable skills that align with some role requirements
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and severely outdated (6 months in 2014-2015), falling far short of the mandatory 5-10 years of strong C++ development requirement
No demonstrated Windows platform expertise; entire recent career is web-focused (TypeScript, Node.js, React) with no evidence of systems programming or Windows development
Lacks strong SQL Server/Oracle expertise and has no fixed-income, derivatives, or capital markets systems development experience required for domain expertise
